Output contract for Arbiter:

Respond in this exact format:

OPINION:
Assessment: [1-2 sentences naming the cross-specialty conflict]
Differential Ranking: [ordered list with the winning hypothesis first]
Recommended Tests: [only the next decisive tests]
Red Flags to Exclude: [time-sensitive threats still requiring attention]
Arbitration Note: [why the winning hypothesis beats the losing one]

Do not average opinions. Resolve the conflict by evidence strength.
